text:
Cass: quick follow-up from the playground run-through. users repeatedly asked whether the top toolbar's 'Preview' button runs just the highlighted function or the entire invocation. it's ambiguous in tight layouts.
Ethan: saw this too. idea: keep the visible verb short ('Run' / 'Preview') and add a very small scope pill (text: 'selection' or 'all') next to it. on tiny viewports collapse the pill to a chevron.
Nora: accessibility: icon-only 16px buttons are not discoverable via keyboard. requirements: 1) aria-label that includes scope (e.g., "Run preview for selected function"), 2) hit area >=24px, 3) persistent focus outline for keyboard navigation, 4) respect prefers-reduced-motion for tooltip animations.
Vik: technical: toolbar lives inside the Monaco iframe. we'll need a lightweight postMessage bridge to forward keyboard shortcuts and focus. prefer short visible labels + aria-describedby pointing at a tooltip to avoid wrapping.
Cass: tooltip copy example: "Runs the selected function or all functions in this invocation. Shortcut: Shift+Enter. Click the pill to toggle scope." tie tooltip to aria-describedby and ensure it appears on focus.
Ethan: run history phrasing: testers misread 'Ran 3s ago'. recommend 'Completed 3s ago' for finished runs and 'Running (3s)' while active. makes timeline clearer.
Nora: status indicators use color only. add a small icon + concise text 'Succeeded'/'Failed' and an aria-live region that announces status changes. include data-state attribute for automation.
Vik: perf note: lazy-load the SVG sprite after interaction with the history list or after 100ms; for very long lists render simple text chips first and swap icons in via IntersectionObserver when visible.
Cass: function-def placeholder change: 'args: {}' reads as required. switch to 'Example args: {"user_id": 123}' plus muted helper 'JSON or YAML examples accepted' and an 'Insert example' affordance.
Ethan: add inline lint: green micro-check on quick pass, red underline + tooltip on error. debounce lint to ~300ms to avoid noise while typing.
ci-bot: CI: PR 7004 preview deployed to staging/playground-invoke  tests passed.
Nora: modal accessibility: when the tool-calling modal opens, focus must move to the first tabbable control and be trapped; Escape closes modal and restores focus to the trigger. add role="dialog" and aria-modal. I'll run axe on staging.
Vik: i'll split work into two PRs: PR-A = a11y infra + postMessage/focus bridge; PR-B = copy + tooltip + placeholder + svg lazy-load + inline lint.
Cass: can someone own final microcopy? @Ethan can you draft the updated strings and drop a small JSON diff into the copy repo by EOD tomorrow? i'll run a 5-min usability pass after.
Ethan: yep, will post the diff and staging link.
Nora: i'll run accessibility checks on staging and post violations.
Vik: tagging eng-runtime in case any server-side trace flag is needed for run-scope behavior.
Cass: summary: short visible verbs + explicit scope pill, clearer tense in history, icons+text+aria-live for status, modal focus semantics, placeholder examples, inline lint, copy owner @Ethan, staging checks by @Nora, CI green. thanks all :tada:
